title: The magical moment
body: The best products have one interaction that feels magical. One moment where it just works and you feel it. That feeling is what makes people tell their friends without being asked.

title: Sidequests are underrated
body: The most interesting things in my life came from following curiosity with no clear payoff. Working as a barista, competing in hackathons, doing metacognition research. None of these were strategic career moves. All of them shaped how I think.
